name: Reference Candidate Retrieval and Similarity Resolver
purpose: Choose the closest approved evidence when the user did not already provide an exact locked reference.

scoring.appliesWhen: no exact explicit primary visual authority is already locked

interpretation.supportingCandidate: 0.70-0.849 or strong content/system evidence but weaker composition

selectionRules: Primary Visual Authority should be one reference unless user explicitly requests synthesis.
Secondary references may fill content/system/state gaps but cannot silently alter composition.
If top candidates are compositionally different and evidence cannot disambiguate, block.
Never average two conflicting masters into a hybrid screen.
Existing same-product screen outranks generic best-practice knowledge.
Composition Knowledge may support the composition lane after screen-archetype resolution, but it cannot supply unverified business content.

For Admin Portal list/form/detail requests without an exact same-domain screen, load the matching Admin Portal composition package as supporting composition evidence and keep Content Authority unresolved until verified.
